A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Neural Logic Networks work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–D are readable and matchable despite reflow and relocation.

before.justification: v3 reports original Boolean-network discovery, tabular classification, medical and industrial application results, plus synthetic-network experiments in Appendix B.1.3.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark tables, application studies and Appendix B.1.3 simulation.

M1.justification: Both retain the same AND/OR neurons, factorized rule modules, objectives and post-processing pipeline. The expanded reset description clarifies reinitialization of the existing modules shown in Figure 5 rather than establishing a new procedure.

E1.justification: Coverage remains four Boolean-network datasets, seven UCI datasets plus the categorical balance variant, binary and multiclass NSL-KDD, and the synthetic networks in Appendix B.1.3.

E2.justification: RRL, ODD and XGBoost remain in Table 3; NN-LFIT, D-LFIT, LF1T and JRip remain in Table D.1; LAD remains in Table 7. The revised prose count of comparable models does not remove XGBoost from evaluation.

E3.justification: Model capacities, regularization, data splits, cross-validation, metrics and synthetic-network settings are retained. Figure 5's added five-dichotomy caption describes an illustration; the experimental default remains 32 fuzzy dichotomies.

E4.justification: The independence-assumption comparison, ground-truth rule recovery and error examples, kidney model-merging analysis, and NSL-KDD transfer and coverage analyses are retained without new tests.

E5.justification: Reporting retains five-fold cross-validation, two repetitions for Boolean-network evaluation, and 30 generated networks per width in Appendix B.1.3. No new seed reporting, uncertainty intervals or significance tests appear.

E6.justification: Numerical tables and plotted results are unchanged, but Table 3's summary is corrected: v3 claims second-best performance among four models except tic-tac-toe; v5 states best or second-best among the three rule-based models except wine. The stated deficit also changes from 5–10% versus XGBoost to approximately 15–25% versus RRL. These revise reported comparative findings, not measurements.

T1.justification: The probabilistic and fuzzy-logical formulations, independence framework, derivations with and without the third approximation, and De Morgan proofs are retained. The wording about distinct concepts and corrections to OR labels and probability notation are clarifications rather than substantive mathematical developments.

C1.justification: The abstract is unchanged. The introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning signed weights, unobserved-data biases, interpretable rule modules, learning procedures and classification applications.

C2.justification: Both retain the causal-identification caveats, independence-approximation limitations, vanishing gradients, rule variability, discretization cost, small medical sample caution and unseen-attack discussion. The mechanism explanations are substantively unchanged; the corrected comparative observations are covered under E6.

D1.justification: Section 3.2.1 now explicitly distinguishes binary reset weights drawn from U(-1,1) from categorical/continuous OR weights drawn from U(0,1). Appendix B.1.2 also identifies the already-derived simplified formulas as those used in the implementation. Code-access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive positioning against prior approaches are unchanged. Numbering the related-work subsection and adding acknowledgments do not introduce cited research or new novelty claims.

P1.justification: v5 adds numbered introduction and experiment subsections, short explanatory introductions and acknowledgments, alongside limited rewrites and terminology edits. The medical rules are reordered and numbered, with an explicit otherwise/no_ckd case. The overall narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: Existing figures and tables are relocated or resized, including Figure B.2 and Table D.1, and appendix algorithms are reordered. Table 1's presentation and Figure 5(b)'s caption are refined. The embedded figure images themselves are identical.

improvement.justification: v5 corrects a misleading performance summary to better match Table 3 and improves implementation documentation and navigation. These are useful, limited gains in accuracy and clarity; the empirical evidence, main method and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
